```{r}
################################################################################
# Organize tcr and clonetype info for downstream analysis plus update new.clone call
################################################################################
T.cells$has.tcr <- T.cells$cloneType != "none"
T.cells$malignant.hyperonly <- T.cells$cloneType == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)"
T.cells$tcr.and.malig <- paste0(T.cells$has.tcr, T.cells$malignant.hyperonly)
table <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(T.cells$orig.ident, T.cells$tcr.and.malig))


meta <- T.cells[[]]
meta <- meta[meta$Dx != "HC",]

table <- subset(table, TRUETRUE > 5)
origins <- rownames(table)
out.list <- list()
for(i in seq_along(origins)) {
  tmp <- meta[meta$orig.ident == origins[i],]
  if(length(which(is.na(tmp$CTaa) == TRUE)) == nrow(tmp)) {
    next()
  }
   
  counts <- tmp %>%
            filter(!is.na(CTaa)) %>%
            group_by(CTaa) %>%
            dplyr::count() %>%
            as.data.frame()
  if(max(counts$n) < 5) {
    next()
  }
 
  denominator <- nrow(tmp[!is.na(tmp$CTaa),])
  top <- counts %>%
    slice_max(order_by = n, n = 10)
  top$prop <- top$n/denominator
  if(max(top$prop) < .05) {
    next()
  }
  top <- top[top$prop > .09,]
  top <- top[top$n > 3,]
  topchain <- top$CTaa
  topA <- stringr::str_split(top$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[1:nrow(top), 1]
  topB <- stringr::str_split(top$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[1:nrow(top), 2]
  chainA <- stringr::str_split(tmp$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
  chainB <- stringr::str_split(tmp$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
  chainA[chainA == "NA"] <- NA
  chainB[chainB == "NA"] <- NA
  chainB[chainB == ""] <- NA

  a.pos <- which(chainA %in% topA)
  b.pos <- which(chainB %in% topB)
  both <- sort(unique(c(a.pos, b.pos)))
  
  meta.add <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(tmp[both,]), major_clone = rep("malignantClones", length(both)), new.proportion = rep(length(both)/denominator, length(both)))
  out.list[[i]] <- meta.add
}

list <- c(1:length(out.list))
rbind <- data.frame()
for(i in seq_along(list)){
rbind <- rbind(rbind, out.list[[i]])
}
clones <- as.vector(rbind$major_clone)
names(clones) <- rownames(rbind)
T.cells$new.clones <- clones

test <- T.cells$new.clones
test[is.na(test)] <- "none"
T.cells$new.clones <- test

T.cells$tcr.and.new.clones <- paste0(T.cells$has.tcr, T.cells$new.clones)

T.cells$malignant.hyperonly <- factor(T.cells$malignant.hyperonly, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
DimPlot(object = T.cells, group.by = "malignant.hyperonly", raster = F)

DimPlot(object = T.cells, group.by = "new.clones", raster = F)
DimPlot(object = T.cells, group.by = "has.tcr", raster = F, cols = c("red", "grey"))
table(T.cells$has.tcr)
```

```{r}
################################################################################
# Seurat anchor transfer predict malignant cells
################################################################################
T.cells.vdj <- subset(T.cells, cloneType != "none")

df <- data.frame(cell_type=T.cells.vdj$orig.ident)
df$barcode <- rownames(df)
row_odd <- seq_len(nrow(df)) %% 2     
row_odd  
df <- df[row_odd == 0, ]

train.anchor.transfer <- df$barcode

T.cells.vdj <- subset(T.cells.vdj, barcode %in% df$barcode)
test <- setdiff(T.cells$barcode, df$barcode)
T.cells.test <- subset(T.cells, barcode %in% test)

###

split.vdj <- SplitObject(T.cells.vdj, split.by = "orig.ident")
split.all.t <- SplitObject(T.cells.test, split.by = "orig.ident")

out <- vector()
for(i in seq_along(all)){
  tmp <- all[i]
  ss <- split.all.t[[tmp]]
  ref <- split.vdj[[tmp]]
  if(nrow(ref[[]]) < 20) {
    next()
  }
  ss <- FindVariableFeatures(object = ss)
  ref <- FindVariableFeatures(object = ref)
  features <- intersect(ss@assays[["RNA"]]@var.features, ref@assays[["RNA"]]@var.features)
  anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = ref, query = ss, dims = 1:10, reference.assay = "RNA", query.assay = "RNA",  features = features, k.filter = NA, k.score = 10, k.anchor = 10, npcs = 10)
predictions.malig <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, refdata = ref$new.clones, dims = 1:10, k.weight = 10)

x <- predictions.malig$predicted.id
names(x) <- rownames(predictions.malig)
out <- append(out, x)

}

T.cells.test$predictions.malig <- out
benchmark.seurat <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(T.cells.test$predictions.malig, T.cells.test$tcr.and.new.clones))
accuracy.seurat <- 100*(benchmark.seurat[1,2]/2+benchmark.seurat[2,3]/2)/(benchmark.seurat[1,2]/2+benchmark.seurat[2,2]+benchmark.seurat[1,3]+benchmark.seurat[2,3]/2)

T.cells.vdj$predictions.malig <- T.cells.vdj$new.clones
T.cells$predictions.malig <-c(T.cells.test$predictions.malig, T.cells.vdj$predictions.malig)
table(T.cells$tcr.and.new.clones, T.cells$predictions.malig)


rm(anchors, clusters, counts, df, knn.gr, meta, meta.add, out.list, predictions.malig, rbind, ref, split.all.t, split.vdj, ss, T.cells.test, T.cells.vdj, table, top, umap, umap.T, a.pos, b.pos, both, chainA, chainB, clones, com, denominator, features, i, keep, out, row_odd, test, tmp, topA, topB, topchain, x)
gc()
```

```{r}
################################################################################
# XGBoost predict malignant cells
################################################################################

table <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(T.cells$orig.ident, T.cells$tcr.and.new.clones))
xg <- subset(T.cells, orig.ident %in% all)
xg.train <- subset(xg, has.tcr == "TRUE")

out <- vector()
train.xgboost <- vector()
for(i in seq_along(all)){
  tmp <- all[i]
  tmp2 <- subset(xg.train, orig.ident == tmp)
  tmp2$train <- sample.split(Y = tmp2$new.clones, SplitRatio = 0.8)
  train.save <- subset(tmp2, train == TRUE)
  query <- subset(xg, orig.ident == tmp)
  train.xgboost <- append(train.xgboost, train.save$barcode)
  test.keep <- setdiff(query$barcode, train.save$barcode)
  test <- subset(xg, barcode %in% test.keep)
  label <- train.save$new.clones
  label <- label == "malignantClones"
  label <- as.numeric(label)
  
  tcr <- quietTCRgenes(train.save@assays[["SCT"]]@data@Dimnames[[1]])
  train <- train.save@assays$SCT@data
  train <- train[tcr,]
  
  tcr <- quietTCRgenes(test@assays[["SCT"]]@data@Dimnames[[1]])
  test <- test@assays$SCT@data
  test <- test[tcr,]

bstSparse <- xgboost(data = t(train), label = label, max.depth = 2, eta = 1, nthread = 16, nrounds = 500, early_stopping_rounds = 8, objective = "binary:logistic", device = "cude")
  importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(model = bstSparse)
  importance_matrix$orig.ident <- tmp
  
    avg <- as.data.frame(AverageExpression(train.save, assays = "SCT", slot = "counts", features = importance_matrix$Feature, group.by = "tcr.and.new.clones"))
    importance_matrix$larger.malig <- avg$SCT.TRUEmalignantClones > avg$SCT.TRUEnone
  
  write.csv(importance_matrix, paste0("~/xgboost.remove.tcr/", tmp, ".csv"))
  pred <- predict(object = bstSparse, newdata = t(test))
  names(pred) <- test@Dimnames[[2]]

out <- append(out, pred)
}
all.test <- setdiff(xg$barcode, train.xgboost)

xg.test <- subset(xg, barcode %in% all.test)
xg.test$xgboost.score <- out
xg.test$pred.xgboost <- xg.test$xgboost.score >0.5

train2 <- train$new.clones
names(train2) <- train$barcode

test2 <- xg.test$pred.xgboost
names(test2) <- xg.test$barcode

train <- subset(T.cells, barcode %in% train.xgboost)
train2 <- train$new.clones
names(train2) <- train$barcode

combine <- c(test2, train2)

unique(T.cells$pred.xgboost)

table(T.cells$tcr.and.new.clones, T.cells$pred.xgboost)

################################################
#read in files, combine, and add directionality

all.xgb.results <- list.files("~/xgboost.remove.tcr")
for(i in seq_along(all.xgb.results)){
  tmp <- all.xgb.results[i]
  tmp2 <- read.csv(file = paste0("~/xgboost.remove.tcr/", tmp))
  if(tmp == "S1.csv"){
    rbind <- tmp2
    next()
  }
  rbind <- rbind(rbind, tmp2)
}
rbind$Gain <- rbind$Gain*100

zzz <- rbind %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(sum(Gain))

rbind$calc <- ifelse(rbind$larger.malig == "TRUE", 1, -1)
rbind$final.value <- rbind$Gain * rbind$calc
zzz.direction <- rbind %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(sum(final.value))
rbind.pos <- subset(rbind, calc > 0)
rbind.neg <- subset(rbind, calc <0)

dif <- intersect(rbind.pos$Feature, rbind.neg$Feature)

zzz.pos <- rbind.pos %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(sum(final.value))
zzz.pos <- zzz.pos[order(-zzz.pos$`sum(final.value)`),]
ggplot(head(zzz.pos, 20), aes(fill=`sum(final.value)`, y=`sum(final.value)`, x=reorder(Feature, -`sum(final.value)`))) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+NoLegend()

zzz.neg <- rbind.neg %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(sum(final.value))
zzz.neg <- zzz.neg[order(zzz.neg$`sum(final.value)`),]
ggplot(head(zzz.neg, 20), aes(fill=`sum(final.value)`, y=`sum(final.value)`, x=reorder(Feature, -`sum(final.value)`))) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+NoLegend()

###################################################################
# Check occurances of genes together with gain > 1%

rbind.strong <- subset(rbind, Gain >1)
list <- unique(rbind.strong$orig.ident)
out <- vector()
for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  ss <- subset(rbind.strong, orig.ident == tmp)
  ss.feats <- unique(ss$Feature)
  occur <- tidyr::crossing(ss.feats, ss.feats)
  occur$both <-  paste0(occur$ss.feats...1, "-", occur$ss.feats...2)
  occur$same <-  occur$ss.feats...1 == occur$ss.feats...2
  occur <- subset(occur, same != TRUE)
  out <- append(out, occur$both)
  names(out) <- tmp
}
occur <- as.data.frame.array(table(out))
rm(avg, bstSparse, importance_matrix, ss, test, train, xg, xg.test, xg.train, out, pred, ss.feats, tcr)
gc()
rbind.xgb <- rbind
occur.xgb <- occur
```

```{r}
################################################################################

ss <- subset(T.cells, orig.ident %in% all)

  tmp <- all.cnv[i]
  tmp2 <- subset(ss, orig.ident == tmp)
  
  df <- data.frame(cell_type=tmp2$tcr.and.new.clones)
  df <- subset(df, cell_type == "TRUEnone")
  df$barcode <- rownames(df)
  df <- df %>% group_by(cell_type) %>% slice_sample(n=round(nrow(df)/2, digits = 0), replace = F)
  
  tmp2$train.cnv.ref <- tmp2$barcode %in% df$barcode
  tmp2$master <- paste0(tmp2$tcr.and.new.clones, tmp2$train.cnv.ref)
  tmp2$master <- tmp2$master == "TRUEnoneTRUE"
  barcodes <- subset(tmp2, master == TRUE)
  barcodes <- barcodes$barcode
  train.cnv <- append(train.cnv, barcodes)

cnv.obj <- CreateInfercnvObject(raw_counts_matrix = GetAssayData(tmp2, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts"), annotations_file = as.matrix(tmp2$master), gene_order_file = "~/gene.position.txt", delim = "\t", ref_group_names = "TRUE")

run.cnv <- run(infercnv_obj = cnv.obj, cutoff = 0.1, out_dir = "~/inferCNV.loop", HMM = T, analysis_mode = "subclusters", k_nn = 10, denoise = T, num_threads = 32, resume_mode = F, cluster_by_groups = T, leiden_resolution = 0.005, HMM_report_by = "subcluster")
```

```{r}
xg.test$xgboost.score <- out
xg.test$pred.xgboost <- xg.test$xgboost.score >0.5
  
benchmark.xgboost <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(xg.test$pred.xgboost, xg.test$tcr.and.new.clones))

accuracy.xgboost.Tissue <- 100*(benchmark.xgboost[1,3]+benchmark.xgboost[2,2])/(benchmark.xgboost[1,2]+benchmark.xgboost[2,2]+benchmark.xgboost[1,3]+benchmark.xgboost[2,3])


################################################
#read in files, combine, and add directionality

all.xgb.results <- list.files("~/xgboost.tissue.remove.tcr")
for(i in seq_along(all.xgb.results)){
  tmp <- all.xgb.results[i]
  tmp2 <- read.csv(file = paste0("~/xgboost.tissue.remove.tcr/", tmp))
  if(tmp == "blood.csv"){
    rbind <- tmp2
    next()
  }
  rbind <- rbind(rbind, tmp2)
}
rbind$Gain <- rbind$Gain*100

rbind$calc <- ifelse(rbind$larger.malig == "TRUE", 1, -1)
rbind$final.value <- rbind$Gain * rbind$calc

rbind.blood <- subset(rbind, orig.ident == "blood")
rbind.skin <- subset(rbind, orig.ident == "skin")
rbind.LN <- subset(rbind, orig.ident == "lymph node")

FeaturePlot(sr.new, features = "NKG7", slot = "counts", raster = F)
FeaturePlot(sr.new, features = "NKG7", slot = "data", raster = F)
```

```{r}
malignant.only <- subset(T.cells, pred.final == "malignantClones")

fastMNN_output <- readRDS("~/fastMNN_output.rds")
keep <- malignant.only$barcode
fastMNN_output <- fastMNN_output[, (colnames(fastMNN_output) %in% keep)]
malignant.only <- subset(malignant.only, barcode %in% fastMNN_output@colData@rownames)
out <- fastMNN_output
rm(fastMNN_output)

set.seed(123)
umap <- runUMAP(x = out, dimred = "corrected")
umap.malig <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            loadings = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            projected = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            assay = "RNA", 
                            key = "umap.malig")
malignant.only[["umap.malig"]] <- umap.malig


knn.gr <- makeKNNGraph(out@int_colData$reducedDims$corrected, k = 10)

clusters <- cluster_leiden(graph = knn.gr,objective_function = "modularity",weights = NULL,resolution_parameter = 0.5,beta = 0.01,initial_membership = NULL,n_iterations = 2,vertex_weights = NULL)
com <- membership(communities = clusters)
malignant.only$knn.leiden.malig.5 <- com

clusters <- cluster_leiden(graph = knn.gr,objective_function = "modularity",weights = NULL,resolution_parameter = 1,beta = 0.01,initial_membership = NULL,n_iterations = 2,vertex_weights = NULL)
com <- membership(communities = clusters)
malignant.only$knn.leiden.malig1 <- com

clusters <- cluster_leiden(graph = knn.gr,objective_function = "modularity",weights = NULL,resolution_parameter = 2,beta = 0.01,initial_membership = NULL,n_iterations = 2,vertex_weights = NULL)
com <- membership(communities = clusters)

malignant.only <- subset(T.cells, pred.final == "malignantClones")

out <- as.matrix(out)

png(file = "~/out.GPU.png", width = 2000, height = 2000)
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = out, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
dev.off()

sig_values <- which(out>=0.6, arr.in=TRUE)
df <- cbind.data.frame(colIDs = colnames(out)[sig_values[, 1]],
                 rowIDs = rownames(out)[sig_values[, 2]], 
                 values = out[sig_values])

df$same <- df$colIDs == df$rowIDs
df <- subset(df, same == FALSE)
table(df$colIDs)
df2 <- as.data.frame.array(table(df$colIDs))
colnames(df2) <- "count"
df2 <- subset(df2, count > 2)

keep <- unique(rownames(df2))



out.subset <- out[which(rownames(out) %in% keep), which(rownames(out) %in% keep)]
png(file = "~/out.GPU.spearman.subset.png", width = 3000, height = 3000)
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = out.subset, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
################ Make Dx specific UMAPs and clusters ##########################

mf <- subset(malignant.only, Dx == "MF")
ss <- subset(malignant.only, Dx == "SS")
fmf <- subset(malignant.only, Dx == "FMF")
pcalcl <- subset(malignant.only, Dx == "PCALCL")

fastMNN_output <- readRDS("~/fastMNN_output.rds")

list <- c("mf", "ss", "fmf", "pcalcl")
list <- toupper(list)
for(i in seq_along(list)){
  dx <- list[i]
  tmp <- subset(malignant.only, Dx == dx)
keep <- tmp$barcode
fastMNN_output.2 <- fastMNN_output[, (colnames(fastMNN_output) %in% keep)]
tmp <- subset(tmp, barcode %in% fastMNN_output.2@colData@rownames)
out <- fastMNN_output.2
set.seed(124313)
umap <- runUMAP(x = out, dimred = "corrected")
umap.dx <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            loadings = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            projected = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            assay = "RNA", 
                            key = "umap.dx")
tmp[["umap.dx"]] <- umap.dx

knn.gr <- makeKNNGraph(out@int_colData$reducedDims$corrected)
clusters <- cluster_leiden(graph = knn.gr,objective_function = "modularity",weights = NULL,resolution_parameter = 0.5,beta = 0.01,initial_membership = NULL,n_iterations = 2,vertex_weights = NULL)
com <- membership(communities = clusters)
tmp$knn.leiden.dx.5 <- com

clusters <- cluster_leiden(graph = knn.gr,objective_function = "modularity",weights = NULL,resolution_parameter = 1,beta = 0.01,initial_membership = NULL,n_iterations = 2,vertex_weights = NULL)
com <- membership(communities = clusters)
tmp$knn.leiden.dx1 <- com

clusters <- cluster_leiden(graph = knn.gr,objective_function = "modularity",weights = NULL,resolution_parameter = 2,beta = 0.01,initial_membership = NULL,n_iterations = 2,vertex_weights = NULL)
com <- membership(communities = clusters)
tmp$knn.leiden.dx2 <- com

clusters <- cluster_leiden(graph = knn.gr,objective_function = "modularity",weights = NULL,resolution_parameter = 3,beta = 0.01,initial_membership = NULL,n_iterations = 2,vertex_weights = NULL)
com <- membership(communities = clusters)
tmp$knn.leiden.dx3 <- com

saveRDS(object = tmp, file = paste0("~/", dx, ".rds"))

}
```

```{r}
# Function to count unique words while ignoring semicolons
count_unique_words <- function(text) {
  # Split the text on semicolons and unlist the result
  words <- unlist(strsplit(text, ";"))
  # Remove any leading or trailing whitespace
  words <- trimws(words)
  return(words)
}

# Apply the function to the DataFrame column and combine the results into a single character vector
all_words <- unlist(lapply(s76@meta.data$v_gene, count_unique_words))

# Count unique words and their occurrences
word_counts <- table(all_words)

# Convert the result to a data frame
result_df <- data.frame(Word = names(word_counts), Count = as.vector(word_counts))
result_df$total <- sum(result_df$Count)
result_df$percent <- 100*result_df$Count/result_df$total
hyper <- subset(result_df, percent > 5)
hyper.keep <- hyper$Word
# Print the result
print(result_df)


# Add a new column "keep" with TRUE/FALSE values
s76@meta.data$keep <- apply(s76@meta.data, 1, function(row) {
  any(sapply(strsplit(row["v_gene"], ";")[[1]], function(v) v %in% hyper.keep))
})

s76.train <- subset(s76, cloneType != "none")
s76.train$combine <- paste0(s76.train$cloneType, s76.train$keep)
table(s76.train$combine)
unique(s76$cloneType)
s76.train <- subset(s76.train, combine != "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)FALSE" & combine != "Medium (0.001 < X <= 0.01)TRUE" & combine != "Rare (0 < X <= 1e-04)TRUE" & combine != "Small (1e-04 < X <= 0.001)TRUE" & combine != "Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)TRUE")
s76.train$combine2 <- paste0(s76.train$cloneType, s76.train$new.clones)

test <- setdiff(s76$barcode, s76.train$barcode)

s76.test <- subset(s76, barcode %in% test)

intersect(x = s76.train$barcode, s76.test$barcode)


table(s76.train$cloneType, s76.train$new.clones)

label <- s76.train$keep
label <- as.numeric(label)
  
tcr <- quietTCRgenes(s76.train@assays[["RNA"]]@data@Dimnames[[1]])
train <- s76.train@assays$RNA@data
train <- train[tcr,]
  
tcr <- quietTCRgenes(s76.test@assays[["RNA"]]@data@Dimnames[[1]])
test <- s76.test@assays$RNA@data
test <- test[tcr,]

bstSparse <- xgboost(data = t(train), label = label, max.depth = 4, eta = .01, nthread = 16, nrounds = 5000, early_stopping_rounds = 8, objective = "binary:logistic", device = "cuda")
```

```{r}
meta <- T.cells[[]]

table <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(T.cells$orig.ident, T.cells$tcr.and.malig))
hc.remove <- which(rownames(table) %in% hc.orig.ident)
table <- table[-hc.remove,]
table.dx <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(T.cells$orig.ident, T.cells$Dx))
hc <- subset(table.dx, HC >0)
hc.orig.ident <- rownames(hc)
origins <- rownames(table)
origins <- origins[1]
out.list <- list()
for(i in seq_along(origins)) {
  tmp <- meta[meta$orig.ident == "S1",]
  if(length(which(is.na(tmp$CTaa) == TRUE)) == nrow(tmp)) {
    next()
  }
   
  counts <- tmp %>%
            filter(!is.na(CTaa)) %>%
            group_by(CTaa) %>%
            dplyr::count() %>%
            as.data.frame()
  if(max(counts$n) < 5) {
    next()
  }
 
  denominator <- nrow(tmp[!is.na(tmp$CTaa),])
  top <- counts %>%
    slice_max(order_by = n, n = 10)
  top$prop <- top$n/denominator
  if(max(top$prop) < .05) {
    next()
  }
  top <- top[top$prop > .09,]
  top <- top[top$n > 3,]
  topchain <- top$CTaa
  topA <- stringr::str_split(top$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[1:nrow(top), 1]
  topB <- stringr::str_split(top$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[1:nrow(top), 2]
  chainA <- stringr::str_split(tmp$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
  chainB <- stringr::str_split(tmp$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
  chainA[chainA == "NA"] <- NA
  chainB[chainB == "NA"] <- NA
  chainB[chainB == ""] <- NA

  a.pos <- which(chainA %in% topA)
  b.pos <- which(chainB %in% topB)
  both <- sort(unique(c(a.pos, b.pos)))
  
  meta.add <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(tmp[both,]), major_clone = rep("malignantClones", length(both)), new.proportion = rep(length(both)/denominator, length(both)))
  out.list[[i]] <- meta.add
}

list <- c(1:length(out.list))
rbind <- data.frame()
for(i in seq_along(list)){
rbind <- rbind(rbind, out.list[[i]])
}
clones <- as.vector(rbind$major_clone)
names(clones) <- rownames(rbind)
T.cells$new.clones <- clones

test <- T.cells$new.clones
test[is.na(test)] <- "none"
T.cells$new.clones <- test
```

```{r}
levels(Idents(pt36))
table(pt36$Monaco.pruned.labels)

cellchat <- CellChat::subsetData(object = cellchat)

cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)

cellchat@idents

png(file = "~/cellchat.png", width = 3000, height = 3000)

for (i in 1:nrow(mat)) {
  mat2 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  mat2[i, ] <- mat[i, ]
  png(file = paste0("~/cellchat/", rownames(mat)[i], "mat.png"), width = 3000, height = 3000)
  netVisual_circle(mat2, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, edge.weight.max = max(mat), title.name = rownames(mat)[i])

}
```

```{r}
fastMNN_output <- readRDS("~/fastMNN_output.rds")
benign <- subset(T.cells, pred.final == "none")
keep <- benign$barcode
fastMNN_output <- fastMNN_output[, (colnames(fastMNN_output) %in% keep)]

rm(fastMNN_output)

umap <- scater::runUMAP(x = out, dimred = "corrected")
umap.benign <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            loadings = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP, 
                            projected = umap@int_colData$reducedDims@listData$UMAP,

FeaturePlot(benign, features = "TRDC", raster = F, reduction = "umap.benign")
```

```{r}
# Quantitative approach to integration
library(lisi)

df <- data.frame(cell_type=asdf$orig.ident)
table(df$cell_type)
df$barcode <- rownames(df)
df <- df %>% group_by(cell_type) %>% slice_sample(n=1000, replace = F)
asdf.ss2 <- subset(asdf, barcode %in% df$barcode)

umap.int <- asdf.ss2@reductions$umap

split <- SplitObject(object = asdf.ss, split.by = "orig.ident")
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = split)
asdf.ss <- ScaleData(asdf.ss)
asdf.ss <- RunPCA(asdf.ss, features = features)
asdf.ss <- RunUMAP(object = asdf.ss, reduction = "pca", dims = c(1:50))
asdf.ss@reductions$umap.int <- umap.int

DimPlot(asdf.ss, reduction = "umap", group.by = "Patient.ID")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf.ss, reduction = "umap.int", group.by = "Patient.ID")+NoLegend()

lisi.res <- lisi::compute_lisi(X = asdf.ss@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings, meta_data = asdf.ss@meta.data, label_colnames = "orig.ident")

lisi.res.int <- lisi::compute_lisi(X = asdf.ss@reductions$umap.int@cell.embeddings, meta_data = asdf.ss@meta.data, label_colnames = "orig.ident")


hist(lisi.res$orig.ident, breaks = 50)
hist(lisi.res.int$orig.ident, breaks = 50)

lisi.res.int$run <- "Post-integration"
lisi.res$run <- "Pre-integration"


lisi.combine <- rbind(lisi.res, lisi.res.int)

desired_order <- c("Pre-integration", "Post-integration")

lisi.combine$run <- factor(lisi.combine$run, levels = desired_order)

ggplot(lisi.combine, aes(x = run, y = orig.ident)) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(title = "Violin Plot of LISI Score Pre and Post-Integration", subtitle = "p-value < 2.2e-16",
       x = "",
       y = "LISI Score") +
  theme_minimal()+
    theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),  # Adjust the size as needed
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),   # Adjust the size as needed
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18)   # Adjust the size as needed
  )

wilcox.test(x = lisi.res$orig.ident, y = lisi.res.int$orig.ident)
```

```{r}
reticulate::py_config()
library(reticulate)
use_python("~/virtualenvs/scvelo/bin/python3.10")


mpl <- import("matplotlib", as = "mpl")
np <- import("numpy", as = "np")
scv <- import("scvelo", as = "scv")

adata <- scv$datasets$pancreas()

emb <- adata$obsm['X_umap']
clusters <- adata$obs$clusters
rownames(emb) <- names(clusters) <- adata$obs_names$values

## get clusters, convert to colors
col <- rainbow(length(levels(clusters)), s=0.8, v=0.8)
cell.cols <- col[clusters]
names(cell.cols) <- names(clusters)

## simple plot
plot(emb, col=cell.cols, pch=16,
     xlab='UMAP X', ylab='UMAP Y')
legend(x=-13, y=0, 
       legend=levels(clusters),
       col=col, 
       pch=16)
```
